items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: The BAME came in on the flute. He replaced Maya.

ctx.x: I had a flute like that. The wooden Maya system.
That's right. The BAME came in on the flute. He replaced Maya.
Yeah. I had a Maya system flute which I got from Fazola. He got from I don't know where and he bought a BAME system silver flute and then I got one and I traded the flute into Whirlands.
